prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), though no clear effect was seen in 4 other tests.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.5% and -10.4%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests that failed or were stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -10.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.6% after noise correction, 7 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Showcase: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a split layout to highlight official adoption details beside a pet preview card. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate across the funnel at 60.9% and long completion times (mean 1017s).)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Compatibility Status Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen during the home waiting phase that verifies graphics compatibility and desktop overlay status. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not appear on the desktop, and waiting median time is 201s.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Post-Setup Companion Voice and Chat Quick Start: Add interactive voice and chat instruction component on the home_intro screen explaining pet interaction shortcuts. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3 emails) regarding how to talk to, control, or hide the desktop pet after setup.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Placement After Pick Friend Stage: Move sign-in after pick_friend so users select their companion before authenticating. (why: Lessons show sign-in relocation boosted completion in past winning tests (+9.0%), and letting users choose a pet first reduces early drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Selection Helper Hint: Display a helpful hint clarifying that path choices can be altered anytime after onboarding in settings. (why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision hesitation.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time and Progress Estimator: Show live dynamic progress and estimated finish time on the waiting screen while background assets build. (why: Home wait step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to abandonment due to lack of feedback.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] Account Cloud Sync Security Incentive Banner: Add a cloud backup verification badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in prevents pet loss. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after re-authenticating.)
7: [adoption, copy] Custom Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Update upload_photos screen copy with explicit photo guidelines regarding lighting and framing. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Path Selection Redesign: Transform the choose_path screen layout into structured cards for companion selection paths. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with an unusually long mean completion time of 514s.)
9: [home, notification] Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is rendered. (why: Long wait times at home step (mean 2336s) cause users to switch windows and forget to finish setup.)
